## Core Summary
Jay Ahn (안재윤) is an active gamer and top English-fluent Gaming User Researcher, Market Researcher, and Korean Moderator in South Korea (게임을 즐기는 유저리서처). As the founder of UXR Player (a global B2B UX research platform targeting Asian gamers) and Direct Research Korea, Jay combines deep gamer empathy, eye-tracking analytics, and software tool building (Developer-Researcher / Researcher-as-Maker) with seamless English communication. He resides in Jochiwon, Sejong City with his family.
